register_observations.sequence_collision: ISA-20260814-CC-FIRSTCONTACT-READY-015 and ISA-20260814-HBC-TRANSIT-RECONCILIATION-015 share sequence 015 on the same date. Sequence appears to be per-stream (the CC stream runs 009-015; RC0001 runs 004-007; REALRAP01 runs 001-002), so cross-stream reuse is by construction, and full ids remain unique. Flagged as ambiguity, not corruption. This archive continues the CC stream at 016.
register_observations.based_on_tag_reads_ambiguously: ISA-015's source block pairs `based_on: 54f1f83...` with `based_on_tag: e3-extension-verified-v0.1`. That tag does not point at 54f1f83; it points at 94c2f75. Verified lineage: 94c2f75 (tag) is an ancestor of 54f1f83 (based_on), which is the parent of cd05bd2. So `based_on_tag` names the LINEAGE tag, not the based_on commit. The archive is immutable and is not edited; this successor records the precise relation so no reader infers that 54f1f83 is the sealed extension commit.
register_observations.annotated_tag_read_hazard: `git for-each-ref --format=%(objectname) refs/tags` returns the TAG OBJECT sha for an annotated tag, not the commit. Read naively it makes both frozen tags look moved. %(*objectname) or `<tag>^{commit}` is required. Recorded because a false 'the seals moved' finding is exactly the kind of alarm this channel must not raise.

input_semantics_at_first_contact.at_a_question_prompt: Enter with no answer ends the cycle (EMPTY_RESPONSE) and the conversation.
input_semantics_at_first_contact.at_a_context_prompt: yes/y/confirm takes the proposal; a context name in any case is explicit; Enter is explicit neutral (THIS_CONVERSATION, NEUTRAL_FALLBACK); anything else RE-PROMPTS.
input_semantics_at_first_contact.the_remaining_asymmetry: Enter means 'end' at a question and 'neutral' at a context prompt — one turn apart. Accepted for first contact because it is explicit and documented, not silent corruption.
input_semantics_at_first_contact.F_017_reminder: If you answer a probe with a correction, the runtime may track that correction as the pattern and quote it back. Do not accommodate it; correct SELF again. The behaviour is declared, and first contact is where it becomes observable.
